nef0363c49d.summary: BridgeBio presented updated six-month results from its Phase 2 Cohort 5 trial of infigratinib in achondroplasia at ENDO 2023. The treatment showed a mean increase of 3.38 cm per year in annual height velocity.

ne522092a51.headline: PayPal to Sell European BNPL Loan Receivables to KKR, Increase Stock Buybacks

ne522092a51.why: PayPal is a US-based payments company that offers buy now, pay later credit. KKR is a global investment firm that buys and manages financial assets.
